story_info.title: Max Monkey's Camping Confidence
story_info.subtitle: A Try-Again Adventure
story_info.moral: Trying again helps us learn and feel brave.

main_character.name: Max Monkey

cover.visual_action: Max happily setting up a small tent

slides.title: Ready to Camp!
slides.text: Max Monkey woke up with a big smile. "Adventure is waiting!" he cheered. Today was special. Max would go camping! He packed his little backpack carefully. A banana, a storybook, and a soft blanket went inside. He was ready for Adventure Jungle.
slides.speaker_notes: Max is excited about his camping trip and packing his bag.

slides.title: A Spot in the Jungle
slides.text: Max swung through the trees. He found a perfect spot. It had soft green grass and pretty flowers. "Time to set up my tent!" he said. He pulled out the colorful fabric. Then he saw the long tent poles.
slides.speaker_notes: Max arrives at his camping spot and gets ready to build his tent.

slides.title: A Tricky Tent
slides.text: Max tried to push the poles together. "Hmm," he said. They did not want to connect. He tried again, pushing harder. Still, they would not click into place. Max felt a tiny bit stuck. He wanted to give up.
slides.speaker_notes: Max encounters a small problem while trying to assemble his tent poles.

slides.title: Trying Again
slides.text: Then Max remembered his friend Maya. "Try again!" she always said. Max looked closely at the poles. He saw a little arrow on one end. "Ah!" he whispered. He lined up the arrows. Click! The poles fit perfectly.
slides.speaker_notes: Max remembers to try again, observes the poles, and finds the solution.

slides.title: Happy Camper Max
slides.text: Max quickly put up his bright tent. He felt so happy! He did not give up. He solved the puzzle. Max snuggled inside with his book. He felt safe and warm. He was proud of himself. Trying again made him feel brave!
slides.speaker_notes: Max successfully builds his tent and feels proud and confident.
